claims: Callao, Peru, is Peru's primary commercial seaport.
Callao, Peru, is a historic constitutional province adjacent to Lima.
Callao, Peru, was founded in 1537.
Jorge Chávez International Airport is located in Callao, Peru.
Real Felipe Fortress is a historic fortress.
Real Felipe Fortress was built to protect Callao's port from pirates and foreign attacks.
The Callao Monumental district is in Callao, Peru.
Callao Monumental has art galleries.
Callao Monumental has colorful murals.
Callao Monumental has street art.
Callao Monumental has fashion stores.
Abtao Submarine Museum is in Callao, Peru.
Abtao Submarine Museum offers tours of a real naval submarine.
La Punta is a district in Callao, Peru.
La Punta has beaches.
La Punta has boardwalks.
La Punta has views of the ocean.
Residents of Callao, Peru, are known as Chalacos.
Callao, Peru, is situated roughly 20-30 minutes outside of Lima city center.
Central areas of Callao like La Punta and Callao Monumental are safe for tourists.
There is a small town named Callao in Virginia, USA.
